# Binding Wire Machine & Industrial Nail Machinery Manufacturer

> Binding Wire Machine is an ISO 9001:2015 certified engineering and machinery manufacturing company based in Aji Industrial Area, Rajkot, Gujarat, India.

## Core Products & Capabilities
- **Automatic Wire Nail Making Machines (IN1+ to IN6):** Heavy-duty crank structure, centralized lubrication, producing nails from 1 inch (25mm) to 6 inches (150mm) at speeds from 150 to 550 nails/min. Wire diameter compatibility: 8 SWG to 16 SWG.
- **Continuous Wire Drawing Plants:** Multi-die continuous wire reduction machines with water-cooled drawing drums, tungsten carbide dies, and Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) panels for mild steel (MS), hard bright (HB), and high-carbon steel wire rods.
- **Binding Wire Making Plants:** Integrated production lines featuring fine wire drawing blocks, pit-type electric annealing furnaces, and automatic spooling machines for soft black annealed GI/MS construction binding wire (20 to 16 SWG / 0.9mm to 1.6mm).
- **Nail Polishing Barrel Drums:** Rotary tumbling barrels designed for de-burring, cleaning, and mirror-polishing wire nails with leather scrap and sawdust.
- **Precision Cutter Grinder Machines:** Dedicated die-sharpening machines for reconditioning wire nail cutting knives, header dies, and gripper dies.

## Key Technical Specifications
- Operational Voltages: 220V / 380V / 415V, 50/60 Hz, 3-Phase configurations for worldwide export.
- Packaging: Export-grade seaworthy wooden crating, VCI anti-rust coating, containerized shipping (FCL/LCL).
- Primary Export Destinations: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Ghana, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal.
